module: Module 5: Partial Fills, Asymmetric Rejections & Slippage
title: Liquidity Provider Rejection on Single Child Order During Fast Market
precondition: Fast market causes LP to reject 1 of 20 child tickets.
expected_result: Rejection isolated; auto-retry routes child order to secondary LP bridge within 100ms; remaining 19 orders fill.
actual_result: Asymmetric LP rejections trigger exponential backoff retry to secondary LP bridge within 100ms.
